subject: general
question: Which one is the spreadsheet application that comes with MS - Office software group?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MS - Excel.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Microsoft Excel**__ is a spreadsheet programme developed by Microsoft.
 
• It includes calculating and computation tools, graphing tools, pivot tables, and Visual Basic for Applications, a macro programming language (VBA).
 
• Excel is a programme that is included in the **MS - Office software group.**
 
• It is a spreadsheet program that is used to save and analyse numerical data.
 
• A spreadsheet is a table with** rows and columns** of information.
 
• A cell is a rectangular box formed by the intersection of rows and columns.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Microsoft Office is a collection of desktop productivity tools created by Microsoft primarily for commercial use.
 
• MS Office includes:
 
 
• **Microsoft Word.**
 
• Microsoft Excel.
 
• **Microsoft PowerPoint.**
 
• Microsoft OneNote.
 
• Microsoft Outlook.
 
• Microsoft Publisher.
 
• **Microsoft Access.**
 
• Skype for Business.
